properties.description: Detects ATT&CK technique T1021.005 (VNC). Adversaries may use [Valid Accounts](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1078) to remotely control machines using Virtual Network Computing (VNC).  VNC is a platform-independent desktop sharing syste
properties.query: CommonSecurityLog| where DestinationIP !startswith "10." and SourceIP !startswith "10."| summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), SourceIP, DestinationIP | where count_ > 5 // AZ-MITRE-ATTACK-025
